newsitem.title: INDIA: India sets up panel for private power transmission.
newsitem.headline: India sets up panel for private power transmission.

text.p: India has set up an expert committee to work out an administrative, financial and legal framework to facilitate private investment in power transmission, the government said in a statement on Monday.

"The committee will suggest guidelines for determination of transmission tariffs including suggestions on operational parameters to be laid down in this regard such as line availability, incentive structure etc," the statement said.

"The committee will also prepare guidelines for negotiations of transmission service agreements," the statement said. "On these issues the committee has been directed to submit its report to the Ministry of Power within two weeks."
The statement said the committee had also been directed to suggest guidelines to help in the selection of private companies for transmission.

India allowed private firms to enter electricity generation under an economic reforms programme launched in 1991. It recently started measures to introduce private participation in power distribution.
